# … 嗎？ · *… maa3?*

**Meaning:** neutral yes/no question · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Sentence-final particles

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

Adding 嗎 to a statement makes it a yes/no question. It is correct and widely understood, though A-not-A questions (去唔去？) sound more colloquial in everyday speech.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你好嗎？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 hou2 maa3? |
| Yale | néih hóu ma? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄇㄚ³? |
| English | How are you? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你係香港人嗎？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 maa3? |
| Yale | néih haih hēung góng yàhn ma? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄏㆦㄥ¹ ㄍㄛㄥ² ㄧㄜㄣ⁴ ㄇㄚ³? |
| English | Are you from Hong Kong? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **有問題嗎？** |
| Jyutping | jau5 man6 tai4 maa3? |
| Yale | yáuh mahn tàih ma? |
| Bopomofo | ㄧㄜㄨ⁵ ㄇㄜㄣ⁶ ㄊㄜㄧ⁴ ㄇㄚ³? |
| English | Any questions? |
